title: 1.2 Introduction to Information Systems
description: Definition, components and examples of information systems

questions.question: What is an information system (IS)?
options: A collection of raw facts stored in a notebook
A series of steps followed to achieve a desired outcome
A set of interrelated components working together to collect, process, store, and disseminate information to potential users
A single computer used for playing games
questions.correctAnswer: A set of interrelated components working together to collect, process, store, and disseminate information to potential users

questions.question: An information system generates different types of information or reports used by employees to do what?
options: Replace all hardware in the organization
questions.correctAnswer: Accomplish different organizational tasks

questions.question: Managers use information to make decisions such as determining what?
options: The color of an office building
The selling price of a product
The number of holidays in a year
questions.correctAnswer: The selling price of a product

questions.question: A school information system captures student data about which types of assessments?
questions.correctAnswer: Quizzes, assignments, and final examinations

questions.question: In the school example, each subject's mark is used to calculate what?
options: The average mark of students and rank them accordingly
questions.correctAnswer: The average mark of students and rank them accordingly

questions.question: Which of the following are the five major components of information systems?
options: Monitors, keyboards, printers, scanners, and speakers
Tables, graphs, charts, formulas, and numbers
Hardware, software, data/information, people, and procedure
Internet, cameras, cables, walls, and roofs
questions.correctAnswer: Hardware, software, data/information, people, and procedure

questions.question: What does the hardware component of an information system include?
options: The salary structure of the employees
The training programs given to employees
Policies and methods to be followed in using a system
Digital devices required to perform core information system functions such as data storage, data processing, and communication
questions.correctAnswer: Digital devices required to perform core information system functions such as data storage, data processing, and communication

questions.question: Communication among the disparate parts of an information system is facilitated through which networks?
options: Telecommunication networks that include wired and wireless networks
questions.correctAnswer: Telecommunication networks that include wired and wireless networks

questions.question: What is software?
options: A physical part of the computer system
A set of instructions that commands the computer hardware to do something
A series of steps followed to achieve a goal
A digital device used for data storage
questions.correctAnswer: A set of instructions that commands the computer hardware to do something

questions.question: Which of the following is included in the software component of an information system?
options: The operating system, the Database Management System (DBMS), application software, and anti-virus software
Policies and methods to use a system
questions.correctAnswer: The operating system, the Database Management System (DBMS), application software, and anti-virus software

questions.question: The various types of data that organizations collect on a regular basis must be stored where?
options: In a computer database for later use
In the memory of the manager
questions.correctAnswer: In a computer database for later use

questions.question: According to the text, data or information is a critical resource or asset that must be handled in what way?
options: Properly managed by the information system
questions.correctAnswer: Properly managed by the information system

questions.question: Information systems require qualified or trained people with knowledge to do what?
options: Operate the technologies and identify new data that must be captured and stored
questions.correctAnswer: Operate the technologies and identify new data that must be captured and stored

questions.question: Technical people who have specialized knowledge of the information system are responsible to do what?
options: Create and manage an information system that is supportive to the organization's daily activities
Disconnect the organization from the network
Delete all the data from the database
questions.correctAnswer: Create and manage an information system that is supportive to the organization's daily activities

questions.question: What is a procedure?
options: A database that stores employee data
A set of instructions that commands the hardware
A digital device used for communication
A series of steps followed to achieve a desired outcome or goal
questions.correctAnswer: A series of steps followed to achieve a desired outcome or goal

questions.question: Procedures are the policies and methods to be followed in doing what?
options: Using, operating, and maintaining an information system
questions.correctAnswer: Using, operating, and maintaining an information system

questions.question: Which of the following is clarified by clear procedures in an organization?
options: What data should be captured, who should have access to the data, and who should have the privilege to modify data
The brand of computers to buy
The color of the office walls
questions.correctAnswer: What data should be captured, who should have access to the data, and who should have the privilege to modify data

questions.question: What does HRIS stand for?
questions.correctAnswer: Human Resource Information System

questions.question: Which kinds of data are stored in the database of a typical HRIS?
options: Recruitment, demographic, performance management, learning management, and compensation and benefits data
questions.correctAnswer: Recruitment, demographic, performance management, learning management, and compensation and benefits data

questions.question: Recruitment data in an HRIS includes which of the following?
options: Applicant's Curriculum Vitae and the number of candidates
questions.correctAnswer: Applicant's Curriculum Vitae and the number of candidates

questions.question: Demographic data in an HRIS includes which of the following?
options: The menu of the company cafeteria
The weather forecast for the week
Employee ID, name, date of birth, gender, position, and residence
questions.correctAnswer: Employee ID, name, date of birth, gender, position, and residence

questions.question: Performance management data in an HRIS refers to which of the following?
options: Feedback, ratings, and achievements of employees
The number of computers in the office
questions.correctAnswer: Feedback, ratings, and achievements of employees

questions.question: Learning management data in an HRIS includes which of the following?
questions.correctAnswer: Training and development

questions.question: Compensation and benefits data in an HRIS includes which of the following?
options: Employee's salary structure and other benefits
questions.correctAnswer: Employee's salary structure and other benefits

questions.question: Which infrastructural resources are used in a Human Resource Information System?
options: Server computer, desktop computer, laptop, and networks
questions.correctAnswer: Server computer, desktop computer, laptop, and networks

questions.question: Which software in an HRIS is used to automate the posting of job offerings as well as the sorting of incoming applications?
questions.correctAnswer: Recruitment software

questions.question: Which software in an HRIS is used to track employee attendance?
questions.correctAnswer: Time and attendance software

questions.question: Performance management software helps the organization to make what kind of decisions?
options: Decisions about the type of vehicles to buy
Decisions about the menu of the cafeteria
Evidence-based decisions to retain, promote, transfer, or terminate an employee
Decisions about the color of the office
questions.correctAnswer: Evidence-based decisions to retain, promote, transfer, or terminate an employee
